thread:
Maya S: quick async: what I did — landed timeout/backoff for upstream auth checks (PR #4125), added metrics for 401 spikes.
Liam K: nice, saw the PR, left a small comment about the retry window.
Maya S: re: retry window — I set it to 500ms -> exponential up to 5s, mostly to avoid hammering the auth service. open to tuning.
Sophia R: blocker: running into a canary that returns 429 on a few routes after the change. looks rate-limit headers show X-Rate-Limit-Remaining dropping fast.
Jonas P: which routes? can you paste the route config?
Sophia R: /v1/gateway/proxy and /v1/keys/prune — both are on the new routing-policy that uses token-based buckets.
Maya S: hmm, I didn't intend to change bucket sizes. I only touched upstream auth. could we be triggering a retry storm?
Sophia R: maybe — the client retries on 401 and now with auth backoff, some requests are queued and then retried in bursts.
Liam K: suggestion: add jitter to retry backoff. small code patch:
```
retry_delay = base * (2 ** attempts) + random.uniform(0, base)
```
This should spread retries.
Maya S: good call. I'll add jitter and deploy to canary.
Jonas P: also can we temporarily raise the rate-limit for the canary service to avoid noisy 429s while we observe?
Sophia R: I can bump the policy for the canary tag to 2x for the next 30m. will do now.
InfraWatcher: deployment queued: canary auth-backoff-jitter v1.3 -> infra-canary-3 (started).
CI Bot: CI passed for PR #4125 with 4 flake8 warnings.
Liam K: quick check: telemetry — we should add a counter for "auth.retry_jitter_applied" so we can see how often jitter is used vs plain backoff.
Maya S: will add metric. anything else?
Sophia R: FYI I'll monitor 429 / latency charts and post a follow-up in 15m.
Jonas P: I'll keep an eye on the gateway dash and rollback if 429s spike.
Maya S: thanks — summary for today: landed auth backoff, adding jitter (deploying), bumped canary rate-limits, adding metric. blockers: none after bump.
Liam K: LGTM :thumbsup:
Sophia R: thanks team, ping me if you see regressions.
Maya S: ping @Liam K for a small review on the jitter math when you have a min.
Liam K: on it, should be quick.
InfraWatcher: canary deployment healthy at 120s, no new 500s.
Sophia R: chart update: 429s down ~30% since bump + jitter applied. will run the 1h observation window and report.
Maya S: awesome — closing this thread in a bit, leave any QA notes here.
CI Bot: reminder: please include changelog entry for auth behavior in PR description.
Maya S: done, added CHANGELOG.md note.
Jonas P: thanks, we'll sync in the next standup if needed.
